title: Best of Ottawa Small Group Tour with Rideau Canal Cruise
includes: See the Centennial Flame and Fairmont Chateau Laurier
National Gallery of Canada (Admission Included) (Seasonal: Replaces Cruise)
Pass Points of Interest: The giant spider sculpture, Royal Mint and Notre Dame Basilica
Narrated Guided Tour of Byward Market
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Your experience begins as you meet your guide at 380 Sussex Drive in-front of the Maman Giant Spider Sculpture.

Enjoy a guided walk toward the vibrant ByWard Market, one of Canada’s oldest and most lively public markets. Along the way, take in stunning pass-bys of the Royal Canadian Mint and the breathtaking Notre-Dame Cathedral Basilica, while your guide shares stories of Ottawa’s rich history and culture.

Continue on toward Canada's Palirament Hill & Centennial Flame, passing the elegant Fairmont Château Laurier along the way. This iconic flame-shaped fountain commemorating Canadian Confederation is a must-see highlight in the capital.

For your final experience, head to the waterfront where you’ll board a relaxing Rideau Canal cruise. Sit back and enjoy scenic views of downtown Ottawa while learning about this UNESCO World Heritage Site. As you board the boat, your guided walking tour concludes, and you’ll continue your experience on the water at your own pace.
